commit.message:
Create subcharts to enable helm dep update (#9306)

* Create subcharts to enable helm dep update

Technical changes:

- helm dep update is defective with the current umbrella model.
- helm dep update is required to introduce third party charts into
  the helm installation.
- helm dep update is required to introduce a minimum pinned version
  for the various CNI use cases that are emerging in the community.
- requirements for `repository: file://` cannot be subdirectories
  of the main helm chart.  To enable helm dep udpate, the components
  must be moved to a subdirectory (in this PR subcharts).
- nodeagent version was incorrectly specified as 1.0.0.
- This PR simply moves around subcharts so that helm dep update is
  usable.

The main goal of this PR is to enable CNI components to be released
independently of the main 3 month cadence for Istio.  This would permit
a dev/alpha/beta/stable release of CNI between 1.1.0 and 1.2.0.  As
other components become available, they could also be released independently
of the 3 month cadence in dev/alpha/beta for technical preview by operators
evaluating Istio.

This PR may have workflow impact for developers.  With our distribution of
Helm charts via istio.io, there is no impact for operators.

* Add `helm dep update` to tests
